DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらはお客様へ連絡する携帯番号の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito ang bahagi ng mobile number para makontak kayo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の番号を書きました。仕事中は会社へかけてほしいと思ったので。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人欄に会社番号を書いた理由を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Numero ng kumpanya ang isinulat ko dahil gusto kong doon tawagan habang nagtatrabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag kung bakit numero ng kumpanya ang nasa personal field. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先の電話と本人の連絡先は別の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaibang bahagi ang telepono ng trabaho at personal contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の携帯はこちらの番号です。勤務先の番号は、会社の代表で私の直通ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯と会社代表の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito ang mobile ko. Main line ng kumpanya ang sa trabaho, hindi direktang numero ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang mobile at main line ng kumpanya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人へ確実に連絡できる番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang numerong mapagkakatiwalaang makakontak kayo mismo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯に変更します。仕事中は出られないので、折り返してよい番号も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人番号へ直し折返しの確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Papalitan ko ng mobile. Hindi ako makasagot sa trabaho, kaya sabihin din ang numerong puwedeng tawagan pabalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itama ang personal number at itanong ang pagtiyak sa callback. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 銀行からの連絡の場合に確認する方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang paraan ng pagtiyak kapag bangko ang tumawag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会社番号は勤務先欄へ書くか、担当に確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先欄の取扱いを別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Salamat. Tatanungin ko muna ang namamahala kung ilalagay ang kumpanya sa workplace field bago sagutan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hiwalay na tiyakin ang paghawak sa workplace field. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。誤記した携帯欄は訂正しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Itama natin ang maling mobile field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 直しました。自分の携帯と会社の代表番号を最後に別々に読み合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの番号を欄別に照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naitama ko na. Sa huli gusto kong hiwalay basahin at pagtugmain ang mobile at main line ng kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pagtugmain ang dalawang numero ayon sa field. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。欄ごとに確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の日付が気になりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この日付は昨日です。もう期限を過ぎていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 製造日を期限として尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Kahapon ang petsang ito. Lampas na ba sa bisa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang manufacturing date bilang expiration. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは製造日です。期限はこちらに別の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Petsa ng paggawa iyan. Hiwalay dito ang expiration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日作った日と、期限は違うんですね。明日の昼に食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌日の利用予定を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Magkaiba pala ang paggawa kahapon at expiration. Bukas tanghali ko gustong kainin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong paggamit kinabukasan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期限だけでなく、保存方法もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi lang expiration, tingnan din ang pag-iimbak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 冷蔵とあります。持ち帰って冷蔵庫へ入れますが、期限の数字はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷蔵条件と期限欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nakasulat na refrigerated. Ilalagay ko sa refrigerator pag-uwi, pero alin ang numero ng expiration?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang refrigeration at expiration field. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの「消費期限」の欄です。時刻の記載もあります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の午前までですね。明日の昼には合わないので、別の商品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻を見て最初の商品をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hanggang bukas umaga. Hindi akma sa tanghalian bukas, kaya ibang produkto ang pipiliin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tingnan ang oras at huwag ituloy ang unang produkto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用予定に合う物の表示を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ihambing ang label ng mga akma sa plano.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらは明日の午後までと確認しました。製造日の早さだけでは選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用時刻に合う代替品を表示で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak kong ito hanggang bukas hapon. Hindi lang sa pagiging bagong gawa pipili.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pumili ng alternatibo ayon sa oras ng paggamit sa label. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。購入後も表示どおりに保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Pagkabíli, itago rin ayon sa label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 夕方の撮影ですか。帰りの道はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kukuha ng litrato sa hapon? Alam na ang daang pauwi?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。暗くなってから光る景色を撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜景待ちと未知の帰路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi pa. Gusto kong kuhanan ang maliwanag na tanawin pagdilim.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang paghihintay sa gabi at hindi alam na daang pauwi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず出口までの道と閉園時刻を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tiyakin muna ang daan sa labasan at oras ng pagsara.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図だけ見ていました。明るいうちに道を歩いて確かめてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明るいうちの経路確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mapa lang ang tinitingnan ko. Maaari bang lakarin at suriin habang maliwanag pa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Nais suriin ang ruta habang maliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。この舗装路が出口につながっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sige. Itong sementadong daan ang papunta sa labasan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度行って戻りました。街灯のない細道は使わず、この道から帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩いて確認した舗装路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nalakaran ko na papunta at pabalik. Dito ako uuwi, hindi sa makitid na daang walang ilaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Piliin ang sementadong rutang nalakaran na. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 閉園までに出口へ向かえる範囲でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maghintay lang sa abot na makakapunta sa labasan bago magsara.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 閉園が日没より早ければ、夜景はここでは撮れないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日没と閉園の順序を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung mas maaga sa paglubog ang pagsara, hindi makakakuha ng night view dito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pagkakasunod ng paglubog at pagsara. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。閉園の案内を優先してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Unahin ang tagubilin sa pagsara.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻を確認して、今日は夕景だけにします。帰路を覚えた舗装路で出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夕景へ目的を変え退園する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak ang oras, kaya panghapong tanawin lang ngayon. Lalabas sa sementadong daang naalala ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Baguhin sa panghapong tanawin at lumabas ng parke. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。時間に余裕を持ってお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Salamat. Umuwi nang may sapat na oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームまでの経路についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。足首を痛めたので、階段を使わず行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足首の事情と階段回避を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Masakit ang bukung-bukong, kaya ayokong gumamit ng hagdan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang bukung-bukong at pag-iwas sa hagdan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: エレベーターの経路があります。少し遠回りになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May rutang elevator. Medyo mas malayo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 距離は歩けます。ただ、小さな段差もあるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さな段差の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya kong lakarin ang layo. Pero sabihin kung may kahit maliit na baitang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong kung may maliliit na baitang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の扉の所に低い段差があります。案内を見ながら進みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: May mababang baitang sa pinto sa daan. Sundan natin ang gabay habang naglalakad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 足を上げられるか、そこまで行って確かめたいです。無理なら支援を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現場を見て支援を相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto kong puntahan at tingnan kung kaya kong itaas ang paa. Kung hindi, maaari bang humingi ng tulong?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Nais tingnan ang lugar at ikonsulta ang tulong. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な支援は係員へお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sabihin sa kawani ang kailangang tulong.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。速く歩くのは難しいので、次の列車に間に合わなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 速さを求めず列車を見送れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Salamat. Mahirap maglakad nang mabilis kaya ayos lang malampasan ang susunod na tren.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi kailangan ang bilis at maaaring palampasin ang tren. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 余裕を持って移動しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maglaan tayo ng sapat na oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 段差の所で止まって判断します。階段がないだけで全部楽だとは考えず進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 段差で移動可否を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hihinto ako sa baitang at magpapasiya. Hindi ko iisiping lahat madali dahil lang walang hagdan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sa baitang magpasya kung kayang magpatuloy. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。難しい所があれば、その場で係員にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Kung may mahirap na bahagi, sabihin sa kawani doon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入届の確認が済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tapos nang suriin ang moving-in notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。借りている駐車場の住所も、これで変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車場契約の住所も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Salamat. Mapapalitan din ba nito ang address sa kontrata ng inuupahang parking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung magbabago rin ang address ng parking contract. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 民間の契約先の登録は、この届出では変更されません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi binabago ng notice na ito ang rehistro sa pribadong kontrata.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駐車場の会社には自分で連絡するんですね。料金の請求先も古い住所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧い請求先を自分で変更すると理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ako palang kokontak sa kumpanya ng parking. Luma pa rin ang billing address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakitang sariling babaguhin ang lumang billing address. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約先へ新しい住所と変更希望をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ipaalam sa pinagkontratahan ang bagong address at hiling na pagbabago.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 転入した証明が必要か、相手に先に聞いた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 証明資料の必要を先方へ聞くか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dapat bang tanungin muna kung kailangan ang patunay ng paglipat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta kung itatanong muna ang kailangang patunay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要書類は契約先の指定をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin ang dokumentong hinihingi ng pinagkontratahan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今すぐ証明書を追加で取らず、管理会社へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定確認まで追加発行を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung gayon hindi muna kukuha ng dagdag na sertipiko ngayon; magtatanong sa management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Maghintay sa kahilingan bago magpagawa ng dagdag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの手続きの案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Narito ang gabay sa ibang proseso.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 市役所の届出は済み、駐車場は未変更と分けて控えます。請求書を見て連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行政届出と未変更契約を分けて控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hiwalay kong itatala na tapos sa city hall at hindi pa nababago ang parking. Titingnan ang bill at kokontak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itala nang hiwalay ang administrative notice at hindi pa nabagong kontrata. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。契約先ごとに必要な手続きを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Tiyakin sa bawat pinagkontratahan ang kailangang proseso.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 変更候補は火曜の午前か木曜の午後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Martes umaga o Huwebes hapon ang pagpipilian.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 火曜なら家族の車で来られそうです。それで決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 候補を確定と受け取ったか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kung Martes baka maihatid ng pamilya. Kumpirmado na ba iyon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung ang pagpipilian ay kumpirmado. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望を伺ってから枠を確認します。まだ確定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Susuriin ang slot pagkatapos marinig ang nais. Hindi pa kumpirmado.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では家族に「候補」と伝えます。車を出せるか今聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 候補として家族確認をしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sasabihin kong opsiyon lang sa pamilya. Puwede bang itanong ngayon kung maihahatid ako?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng family check bilang opsiyon pa lang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。確認中に空き状況が変わる可能性はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sige. Posibleng magbago ang bakante habang nagtatanong.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木曜なら送迎できると返事が来ました。木曜の午後を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送迎可能な木曜を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sumagot silang Huwebes puwedeng maghatid. Huwebes hapon ang gusto ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Piliin ang Huwebes na puwedeng ihatid. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その枠を確認します。少々お待ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。火曜は選ばないので、候補を二つとも予約しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二重予約をしない意向を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Hindi ko pipiliin Martes, kaya huwag parehong opsiyon ang i-book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Linawing walang duplicate booking. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 木曜の予約が取れました。この時刻です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nakuha ang Huwebes. Ito ang oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今度は確定した時刻として家族へ伝えます。新しい予約票も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定後に送迎へ正しい時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ngayon sasabihin ko sa pamilya bilang kumpirmadong oras. Titingnan din ang bagong slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang tamang oras sa maghahatid pagkatapos makumpirma. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。変更後の票をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車はご自身の物ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りた自転車です。返却場所にあると思ったのですが、番号の車体が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借用車で所在不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hiniram. Akala ko nasa return point, pero hindi ko makita ang bisikletang may numerong iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang hiniram na bisikletang hindi makita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返却の操作は完了していましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: アプリの記録を見ます。完了ではなく「利用中」と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却未完了の表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Titingnan ang app record. “In use” ang lumalabas, hindi completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang display na hindi pa tapos ibalik. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理する事業者へ状態を確認する必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kailangang tiyakin ang estado sa operator na namamahala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私が別の所へ置いてしまった可能性もあります。最後の写真がここです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の置忘れ可能性と写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Posibleng naiwan ko sa ibang lugar. Ito ang huling larawan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang larawan at posibilidad na naiwan sa iba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の場所と、今探した場所は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pareho ang lugar sa larawan at ang hinanapan ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違いました。写真には川側の看板があります。先に事業者へその場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真と探索地点の違いに気付く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi pala. May riverside sign sa larawan. Ipapaaalam ko muna sa operator ang lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mapansin ang kaibahan ng larawan at hinanapan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で確認できた事実を、分けてお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay na sabihin ang mga katotohanang natiyak ninyo mismo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 盗まれたと断定せず、利用中の表示と置いた可能性のある所を伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 盗難と断定せず管理者へ事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi ko sasabihing tiyak na ninakaw; sasabihin ang “in use” at posibleng naiwanang lugar para kumonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay sa operator ang katotohanan nang hindi hinuhusgang nakaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。管理者の確認結果も必要ならお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipaalam din ang resulta ng operator kung kailangan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送の記録が必要ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。契約書を送ります。ここでもらう控えで相手が受け取ったと証明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送控えで受領証明できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Kontrata ang ipapadala. Mapapatunayan ng resibo rito na natanggap ng kabila?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung dispatch receipt ay katibayan ng pagtanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送受付の控えと、受け取りの記録は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang dispatch acceptance receipt at rekord ng pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送った時点では相手はまだ受け取っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送時点と受取時点を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Noong ipadala hindi pa natatanggap ng kabila.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang oras ng pagpapadala at pagtanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。どのような記録が必要か、契約先の指定をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Tiyakin sa kabila kung anong rekord ang kailangan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 指定には到着を確認できる方法とあります。受取状況を追える方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先方の到着確認指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nakasulat na paraang mapapatunayang dumating. Gusto kong kumonsulta sa pag-track ng pagtanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang kahilingan ng kabilang panig sa pagdating. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追跡などの取扱いをご説明します。証明として十分かは提出先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang tracking at iba pa. Sa tatanggap tiyakin kung sapat bilang katibayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて先方へ確かめます。発送控えは受領済みの紙として出さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明後に証拠条件を先方へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakikinggan ko at itatanong sa kanila. Hindi isusumite ang dispatch receipt bilang patunay na natanggap na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang kundisyon ng ebidensiya sa kabila matapos ang paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に方法を決めていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos tiyakin, puwedeng piliin ang paraan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この方法でよいと先方から返事が来ました。発送後は記録番号で受取状況も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 了承された方法で送り結果も調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sumagot silang ayos ang paraang ito. Pagkapadala titingnan ko rin ang pagtanggap gamit ang reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipadala sa pinayagang paraan at tingnan ang resulta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。控えを保管し、配送の結果をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Itago ang resibo at tiyakin ang delivery result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与受取用の口座をお考えですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nag-iisip ng account para sa suweldo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同僚がここを使っているので、私も必ずここで作る必要があると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚と同じ銀行が必須と思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Dito ang kasamahan, kaya akala ko kailangan ding dito magbukas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang kailangan ang bangko ng kasamahan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社から銀行の指定はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。よく読むと「他の金融機関も可」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他行可の会社案内を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong papel. Kapag binasa nang mabuti, puwede rin ang ibang financial institution.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Basahin muli ang gabay na puwede ang ibang bangko. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場合、お持ちの口座が使えるか会社にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung ganoon, itanong sa kumpanya kung puwede ang kasalukuyang account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分名義の口座は別の銀行にあります。新しく作る前に会社へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既存本人名義口座を使えるか会社へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: May account ako sa ibang bangko sa sarili kong pangalan. Magtatanong muna bago magbukas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong sa kumpanya kung magagamit ang sariling umiiral na account. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報をその口座から確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin mula sa account na iyon ang kailangang impormasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社は今の口座でよいと返事をくれました。今日は開設申込みをしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認結果により新規開設をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sumagot ang kumpanya na puwede ang kasalukuyan. Hindi ako mag-aaplay ng bago ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag magbukas ng bago ayon sa kumpirmasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。口座情報はご自身で正しく会社へ提出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Isumite mismo nang tama ang account details sa kumpanya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行名と支店、番号、名義を確認します。同僚の情報を写さず自分の物を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の口座情報を正確に提出すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Titingnan ang bangko, branch, numero, at pangalan. Hindi kokopya sa kasamahan; sarili ang ibibigay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang isumite nang tama ang sariling account details. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。必要があればまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganoon nga. Kumonsulta muli kung kailangan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札のことでご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。特売の二百円で買いたいのに、通常価格になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 特売が反映されないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Gusto ko sa sale price na dalawang daang yen, pero regular price ang lumalabas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong bakit hindi lumabas ang sale. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この札は明日からの予告です。開始日はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Advance notice iyan para bukas. Narito ang simula.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 曜日だけ見て今日と思いました。今日の価格はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始日を理解し今日の価格を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Araw lang ang tiningnan ko at akalang ngayon. Magkano ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawain ang simula at itanong ang presyo ngayon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三百円です。明日の在庫は今はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tatlong daang yen. Hindi mapapangako ngayon ang stock bukas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日一つ必要なので一つだけ買います。明日買う予定の分は、取り置きできるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要量を減らし翌日取り置きを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kailangan ko ang isa ngayon kaya isa lang. Para sa balak bilhin bukas, maaari bang ipareserba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Bawasan ang dami at ikonsulta ang reserba bukas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この特売では取り置きは受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Walang reservation para sa sale na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では明日分を確保したとは考えません。今日は必要な一つでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確保不可を了承し今日の一つを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung gayon hindi ko iisiping nakaseguro ang bukas. Ang kailangang isa ngayon lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tanggapin ang walang reservation at pumili ng isa ngayon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かごに二つありますが、一つ戻しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: May dalawa sa basket. Ibabalik ang isa?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一つ戻して今日の三百円で払います。予告の日付も次から見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余分を戻し通常価格で支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Ibabalik ang isa at babayaran ang tatlong daang yen ngayon. Sa susunod pati petsa ng notice titingnan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibalik ang sobra at magbayad ng regular price. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一つ分でお会計します。
